description: This PHP source file defines the CustomerOrder class within an OpenCart admin extension. The class manages the customer order report functionality, including displaying, filtering, and saving report settings, and generates output views for reports. It handles routing for report pages, loading necessary models and language files, and constructing data for views like order lists and configurations.

classes.name: CustomerOrder
classes.description: Controller class for handling customer order reports in the OpenCart admin interface, providing methods for viewing, filtering, saving settings, and generating report data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial page load for the customer order report, setting up breadcrumbs, loading language and view components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of report configuration settings via POST request, with permission checking.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the customer order report, including filtering options and data list.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of customer orders in response to an AJAX request or similar.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches filtered customer order data, applies pagination, and renders the report list view.
